name: ui-table-view
description: TableView — sortable, selectable data table rendering rows over configurable columns, with inline row actions and grouping. — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui table-view pattern).

schema.description: TableView — sortable, selectable data table rendering rows over configurable columns, with inline row actions and grouping. — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui table-view pattern).
schema.name: ui-table-view

accepts.description: When set, the container accepts drops whose dragGroup matches this value (or '*' for any group)
accepts.label: Accepts

ariaBusy.description: This region is updating; assistive technology waits before announcing it.
ariaBusy.label: Aria-busy

ariaCurrent.description: Marks the current item in a set: the current page, step, location, date or time.
ariaCurrent.label: Aria-current

ariaDescribedby.description: Id of the element whose text describes this one (help text, error).
ariaDescribedby.label: Aria-describedby

ariaExpanded.description: Whether the element it controls is expanded.
ariaExpanded.label: Aria-expanded

ariaHidden.description: Hide from assistive technology (decorative content only).
ariaHidden.label: Aria-hidden

ariaLabel.description: Accessible name read by screen readers when the visible text is missing or not descriptive (e.g. an icon-only control).
ariaLabel.label: Aria-label

ariaLabelledby.description: Id of the element whose text names this one.
ariaLabelledby.label: Aria-labelledby

ariaLive.description: Announce changes to this region: polite waits for a pause, assertive interrupts.
ariaLive.label: Aria-live

ariaSelected.description: Whether this item is selected (tabs, options, grid cells).
ariaSelected.label: Aria-selected

className.description: Additional CSS classes applied to the table root.
className.label: Class Name

columns.description: Column definitions. The compiler emits `columns`; `fields` is the alias.
columns.label: Columns

dir.description: Text direction of this element's content.
dir.label: Dir

dndItemIdField.description: Row field used as the @dnd-kit draggable id (default 'id')
dndItemIdField.label: Dnd Item Id Field

dndRoot.description: Mark this container as the DnD root for its subtree — descendant zones share one DndContext (cross-container drag). Use on an outer container whose own items are not draggable.
dndRoot.label: Dnd Root

dragGroup.description: When set, items in this container are draggable and announce this group as their source
dragGroup.label: Drag Group

dropEvent.description: Bus event fired on cross-container drop. Payload: { id, sourceGroup, targetGroup, newIndex }
dropEvent.label: Drop Event

emptyDescription.description: What will appear here once rows exist.
emptyDescription.label: Empty Description

emptyIcon.description: Domain icon for the empty state.
emptyIcon.label: Empty Icon

emptyMessage.description: Message shown when there are no rows.
emptyMessage.label: Empty Message

enter.description: How this element animates in when it mounts (theme-styled); overrides the theme's default slot entry. `none` opts out.
enter.label: Enter

enterDelay.description: Stagger step for the entry: waits this many `--motion-enter-stagger` steps before animating.
enterDelay.label: Enter Delay

groupBy.description: Group rows under section headers by a field value.
groupBy.label: Group By

itemActions.description: Per-row actions, collected under a trailing kebab overflow menu.
itemActions.label: Item Actions

itemClickEvent.description: When set, the whole row is clickable and emits UI:{itemClickEvent} with { id, row } (action-button clicks stopPropagation so they still win). Mirrors DataList's contract. Omit = rows are not clickable.
itemClickEvent.label: Item Click Event

lang.description: Language of this element's content (BCP 47, e.g. ar, sl, en).
lang.label: Lang

look.description: Layer 2 visual treatment — mirrors the data-list / entity-table look enum so authors share one knob name across row renderers.
look.label: Look

pageSize.description: Max rows before a 'Show More' button. Defaults to 0 (show all).
pageSize.label: Page Size

positionEvent.description: Bus event fired N times per drop (one per item in affected zones) so the trait can persist new positions for the WHOLE zone, not just the moved item. Payload: { id, position }
positionEvent.label: Position Event

relationsData.description: Relation display data: { fieldName: [{value, label}] } — injected server-side by the runtime (relation-option injection) or bound by compiled codegen; resolves stored foreign ids to display names for a column whose field is relation-typed. Same contract DetailPanel takes.
relationsData.label: Relations Data

reorderEvent.description: Bus event fired on in-container reorder. Payload: { id, oldIndex, newIndex }
reorderEvent.label: Reorder Event

role.description: WAI-ARIA role when the element's native semantics don't describe it.
role.label: Role

selectEvent.description: Event emitted on selection change: UI:{selectEvent} with { selectedIds }.
selectEvent.label: Select Event

selectable.description: Render a leading checkbox column. Selection changes emit `selectEvent`.
selectable.label: Selectable

selectedIds.description: Currently-selected ids (controlled). Falls back to local state when omitted.
selectedIds.label: Selected Ids

selfFetch.description: true (default) = standalone mount self-populates on INIT. false = a composing atom owns the fetch and routes its loaded event here — suppresses the wrapper's own un-hydrated fetch so it cannot race the composer's.
selfFetch.label: Fetch its own rows on mount?

skeleton.description: Skeleton drawn while loading, and the shape an empty slot shows while this element's server render is in flight (`none` opts out).
skeleton.label: Skeleton

sortColumn.description: Current sort column (display hint for the active header arrow).
sortColumn.label: Sort Column

sortEvent.description: Event emitted on sortable-header click: UI:{sortEvent} with { column, direction }.
sortEvent.label: Sort Event

sortable.description: Enable in-container reorder; items can be dragged to new positions among siblings
sortable.label: Sortable

surface.description: Content surface: `auto` paints the theme's surface behind this block unless it already sits on one (a card, dialog or another block); `none` opts out.
surface.label: Surface

tabIndex.description: 0 puts the element in the Tab order; -1 makes it focusable only programmatically.
tabIndex.label: Tab Index

viewerRole.description: The viewer's role that each action's `roles` is checked against; bind it at the call site (e.g. `viewerRole: @user.role`). Empty = only actions with no `roles` show.
viewerRole.label: Viewer's role

emits.description: When set, the whole row is clickable and emits UI:{itemClickEvent} with { id, row } (action-button clicks stopPropagation so they still win). Mirrors DataList's contract. Omit = rows are not clickable.
